Name: Amazon.com Inc
Description: Amazon.com, Inc. is a leading American multinational technology company renowned for its diverse operations in e-commerce, cloud computing, digital streaming, and artificial intelligence. As one of the Big Five in the U.S. information technology sector, alongside notable peers like Google and Microsoft, Amazon significantly shapes both economic trends and cultural dynamics globally. With its robust Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud platform and a comprehensive e-commerce ecosystem, the company has established itself as a transformative force and the world's most valuable brand, driving innovation and consumer engagement on an unprecedented scale.
